Thus, Anjudi represents the idea of receiving a precious gift from the world and the people around us, including our parents, family, and community.

We are all recipients of His Divine Grace and Favors, which enable us to lead productive and fulfilling lives. Anjudi serves as a constant reminder of our spiritual connection to the Divine and inspires us to express our gratitude for the countless blessings in our lives. By focusing on the blessings in our lives, we can cultivate a deep sense of contentment, happiness, and inner peace.
